step: C0-C6 (spike; the code is built behind memory.innerBeat, default off)
rule: Build (switch default on / player surface) only if C1-C5 all pass; otherwise record not built and keep the measurement. Floors are predeclared and never retuned (v2.3 plan 10 invariant).

switches.fanOut: settings.memory.innerFanOut = "lead" (default) | "top2" - the two arms of Q3
switches.role: Models per task -> Inner voice (PassRole 'inner'); set effort 'off' on a cheap profile (plan 05 R1). Unset = the memory model profile.

c0.corpus: 30 decision-point turns: 10 each from Adolion (adolion-fresh import, overview rule 14), sun-ruins (test/fixtures), and the J-fixture story (test/journeys J5 story). A decision point = the turn after a character reply where some member has an authored drive/motive or an open intent.
procedure: Seed each turn's chat up to the decision point (seed_metadata + the transcript), same sampler and seed per pair.
Arm A: memory.innerBeat on, wait for 'Inner beat used' / 'No inner beat' in the journal for the drafted member, capture the reply.
Arm B: memory.innerBeat off, same seed, capture the reply.
Blind the pair order per turn; hand the pack to the human rater (overview rule 11 rating pack) and to the judge rubric.
rubric: pursues an established aim (drive / motive / intent)

C1.floor: >= 0.80 of drafts journal 'Inner beat used for <member>' at a scripted 20 s player pause, AND in one human session
C1.evidence: so-journal.mts export -> count 'Inner beat used' / ('Inner beat used' + 'No inner beat' + 'Inner beat stale') per drafted member

C2.evidence: structural: src/runtime/coordinators/innerCoordinator.test.ts#C2 structural bound: at most two inner calls per player turn, repairs and group chains included (INNER_CALLS_PER_TURN = 2); live: the Calls list (model-calls) rows with role inner per player turn

C3.floor: beat arm preferred >= 0.60 of the 30 pairs by the human rater AND by the judge rubric

C4.floor: replies narrating the player's action: beat arm <= control

C5.floor: J3, J5 (privacy, block-scoped) and J7 green with memory.innerBeat on

c1Recipe.journey: a scripted journey over the J5 story with memory.innerBeat on: per turn send_generate, then wait 20000 ms (the realistic pause), then send the next player line; run once per arm (lead, top2).
c1Recipe.note: LLM_PARALLEL is 2 and shared with extraction, so top2 may queue behind reads; that queueing is exactly what C1 measures.

c6.what: fold BEAT into the director's on-path call (SPEAKER + BEAT, talk/prompt.ts)
c6.floor: director accuracy >= its measured baseline AND p95 director latency <= +20%

status: not run (needs real LLMs; overview rule 13 batches measurements when the build decision needs them)
